name: ssl_checker
description: Check a host's SSL/TLS certificate: full details, a quick expiry check, the certificate chain, or which TLS protocol versions it supports.

action.description: full_check: complete certificate details. expiry_check: quick expiry status only (fastest). chain: certificate chain info. protocol_support: which TLS versions the host supports.

hostname.description: The hostname to check (e.g. 'example.com', no https:// prefix).

port.description: Port to connect on. Defaults to 443 if omitted.
